notes.title: Alpha Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello Last Hope Community! I want to fill you guys in on what I've been working on the last couple of weeks as we get the Alpha playtest started and open (You can join right now!) 

So, I've been working on a new map to replace the current one. It's called "Museum" And it'll be added to the game in the next update (Which should be within the next week or so) It's not finished, and I want to stress that. However, it puts my mind at ease knowing that I own the rights to the maps that are playable and am not risking the game getting taken off steam. 

I'm also working on some small balancing and QOL things here and there, but I'll go more in-depth on those when the update drops. 

I also want to announce that the ranked system is working as intended and in line with the competition held in our discord, we will be making ranks visible to all players by the end of the Alpha. Our lobby system is also having huge success in terms of development and I feel like I've made some amazing progress in getting all of the things people have asked for in the game quite quickly. Outside of the huge re-works that are coming. 

Thank you all for supporting the game in any capacity. And I look forward to getting you guys a game that matches my original vision super soon. I can't wait to show off some of the things I've been working on!

Best wishes

The Dectre Media team.
